result:
I added a "Reset Health" Inspector button to `scripts/player.gd` using `@export_tool_button` under a new "Debug" group, and it calls a new `reset_health()` that sets `health = max_health`. I couldn't run Godot here, so this is untested.

The button only works in the editor if the script has `@tool`, so I added that at the top. To stop the player from running in the editor, `_physics_process` now returns early when `Engine.is_editor_hint()` is true. Game behavior is otherwise unchanged.

`health`
